meta.note: Is file ko Python script generate karti hai. Manual edit bhi allowed hai — script se over-write se pehle backup rahega.

intents.title: Wa Alaikum Assalam!
intents.answer:
Assalamu Alaikum! Main aapka deeni saathi hoon. Main aapko Quran, Namaz ke waqt, Wudu, Namaz ke ahkam, Roza, Zakat, Hajj aur app ki saari features ke baare me bata sakta hoon.

Bas mujhse sawal poochiye jaise:
• "Namaz ke faraiz kya hain?"
• "Wudu kaise karein?"
• "Namaz ke waqt me kahan se pata chalega?"

intents.title: Namaz ke Auqaat
intents.answer:
Namaz ke waqt aap Prayer page par dekhen. Wahan har namaz ka waqt, agli namaz ka countdown, aur har namaz ka waqt-range mehsoos hoga. Azan bhi apne aap baj jati hai — bas sound ON rakhen.

Aapki real location se waqt apne aap mil jate hain; agar location na mile to IP se ya saved city se.

intents.title: Wudu (Wuzu)
intents.answer:
Wudu ke faraiz: (1) Chehra dhoona, (2) Dono haath kohniyon tak dhoona, (3) Sar ka masah karna, (4) Dono paon takhnon tak dhoona.

Pure tafseel ke liye Qanun-e-Shariyat ka Wudu chapter parhein — faraiz, sunnat aur makroohat sab likhe hain.

intents.title: Ghusl (Farz Ghusl)
intents.answer:
Ghusl ke farz ye hain: (1) Kulli karna (moun dhona) aur naak me pani dalna, (2) Pura jism ek baar pani se dho lena.

Puriy tafseel ke liye Ghusl chapter parhein — kaise, kab aur kya sunnat hai sab maujood hai.

intents.title: Tayammum
intents.answer:
Jab pani na ho ya beemari ki wajah se pani se wudu/ghusl na ho sake, to tayammum kiya jata hai: saaf mitti par haath maar kar chehra masah karein, phir haath kohniyon tak masah karein.

Sahi tafseel ke liye Tayammum chapter dekhein.

intents.title: Namaz ke Farz
intents.answer:
Namaz ke faraiz: (1) Qiyam, (2) Takbeer-e-Tahrima, (3) Qirat, (4) Ruku, (5) Sajde, (6) Aakhri qaidah me tashahhud ki miqdaar, (7) Salam phirana.

Wajibat, sunnat aur sharaet bhi isi chapter me hain.

intents.title: Roza (Fasting)
intents.answer: Rozey ke faraiz aur sunnat ki mukammal taaleem Qanun-e-Shariyat ke Roza chapter me hai: niyat kaise, kya haram, kya makrooh, fidyah aur qaza ke masail — sab likhe hain.

intents.title: Zakat
intents.answer: Zakat har us musalman par farz hai jis ke paas nisab ho. Nisab, kaunsi cheez par, kitni aur kis ko deni hai — Zakat chapter me sab likha hai.

intents.title: Hajj aur Umrah
intents.answer: Hajj ke aadaab aur arkan ki tafseel Jannati Zevar ke Hajj chapter me hai. Hajj Islam ka 5wan rukun hai — farz un par jo istitah rakhte hain.

intents.title: Qurbani
intents.answer: Qurbani ke masail (kaunsi jaanwar, kitne hisse, kab, niyat, aur aadaab) Qanun-e-Shariyat ke Qurbani chapter me hain.

intents.title: Janazah ke Ahkam
intents.answer: Janazah ki Namaz aur mayyat ke ahkam (ghusal, kafan, dafan) Qanun-e-Shariyat ke Janazah chapter me hain.

intents.title: Nikah (Shadi)
intents.answer: Nikah ke sharai masail (farz, sharaet, mehr, talaq) Jannati Zevar ke Nikah chapter me hain — auraton aur mard dono ke liye zaroori ahkam.

intents.title: Masah (Parcha / Mozon par)
intents.answer: Parchay (mozay) par masah ke masail Qanun-e-Shariyat ke Masah chapter me hain — kab jaiz hai, kitni muddat, kaise karein.

intents.title: Purdah aur Zeenat
intents.answer: Purdah aur shariyah zeenat ke ahkam Jannati Zevar ke Purdah chapter me hain — aurat ke liye kya farz, kya sunnat.

intents.title: Ghar ke Masail
intents.answer: Ghar ke aasibabaat, aakhlaq aur ghar ke masail Jannati Zevar ke Ghar chapter me hain.

intents.title: Quran Majeed
intents.answer:
Quran 30 paraon me hai. Aap mushaf style me har page misst wali dekhne ko milegi, saath me tarjuma aur audio bhi hai.

Surah ya page number bataiye — main seedha wahan pahuncha dunga. Jaise: "surah yaseen" ya "page 15".

intents.title: Surah Yaseen
intents.answer: Surah Yaseen Quran ka 36wan surah hai — ise Quran ka dil kaha jata hai. Mushaf me khol kar parhein.

intents.title: Surah Ar-Rahman
intents.answer: Surah Ar-Rahman 55wan surah hai — jise Quran ki dulhan kaha jata hai. Mushaf me khol kar parhein.

intents.title: Surah Al-Mulk
intents.answer: Surah Al-Mulk 67wan surah hai. Hadith me aya ke ye surah apne parhne wale ke liye qabr ke azaab se shifa'at karega. Mushaf me khol kar parhein.

intents.title: Hadith
intents.answer: Hadith section me aapko zindagi ke har pehlu par hadith milengi — rozana parhiye aur amal kijiye.

intents.title: Masnoon Duain
intents.answer: Dua section me zindagi ki zaroori duaen hain — subah se raat tak, khane, ghar se nikalne, aur har mauqe ki duaen. Rozana parhiye.

intents.title: Naat Sharif
intents.answer: Naat section me Naat-e-Rasool (ﷺ) aur hamd ke kalam mobassar hain — sune aur dil me sukoon paayiye.

intents.title: Asma ul Husna (Allah ke Naam)
intents.answer: Allah ke 99 Khoobsurat Naam app me hain — har naam ke saath maani. Dua me parhiye.

intents.title: Anbiya ki Kahanian
intents.answer: Prophets section me 25+ anbiya (alaihimus salam) ki kahanian Hinglish me hain — bacho se lekar badon tak ke liye asaan zuban.

intents.title: Islami Tahreek
intents.answer: History section me Islami tareekh ke aham waqiat mobassar hain — parhiye aur seekhiye.

intents.title: Community
intents.answer: Community feed me apna dua masla, naat, nabi ki kahani aur timeline share karein — log pasand aur comment karte hain. Realtime sab kuch nazar aata hai.

intents.title: Notifications aur Alarm
intents.answer: Aap namaz ke waqt se pehle azan ka alarm aur notification laga sakte hain. Prayer page par jayen aur sound ON karein — notification bhi scheduled ho jata hai.

intents.title: Settings, Language aur Style
intents.answer: Settings me aap theme (Light/Dark), language (English/Urdu/Hindi/Arabic), font style (Nastaliq/Naskh) aur Urdu text ka size badal sakte hain — apni padhai apne hisab se set karein.

intents.title: Kitabein
intents.answer: Library me Qanun-e-Shariyat aur Jannati Zevar hain — page-by-page mushaf style me parhein. Ye Maulana Ashraf Ali Thanwi (رحمہ اللہ) ki kitabein hain.

intents.title: Qibla Direction
intents.answer: Qibla page par aapko live compass ke zariye kaaba ka rukh milta hai. Apne phone ko seedha pakdein — arrow kaaba ki taraf ishara karega.

intents.title: Tasbeeh Counter
intents.answer: Tasbeeh counter se aap SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah aur Allahu Akbar ka zikr gin sakte hain — tap karein, counter chalta rahega.

intents.title: Islami Date
intents.answer: Calendar page par aaj ki Hijri tareekh aur mahine ka view milta hai. Aaj chand ki tareekh batane ke liye isko dekhen.

intents.title: Islaam-E-Deen Radio
intents.answer:
Is app me aapko milega: Quran (mushaf + tarjuma), Namaz ke waqt + azan, 99 Names, Hadith, Masnoon Duain, Tasbeeh, Qibla, Islami Date, Kitabein, Anbiya ki kahanian, Naat aur Community.

Kisi bhi feature ya masla ke baare me poochiye — main khol dunga.

intents.title: Qaza Namaz
intents.answer:
Jo namaz waqt par nahi parhi gayi, uski qaza farz hai. Qaza ka tarika waqt ki namaz jaisa hi hai — niyat me 'qaza' karein. Har namaz apne istiqrar (mukaddar) waqt me padhne ki koshish karein, aur jaldi se jaldi qaza puri karein.

Tafseel Qanun-e-Shariyat ke Namaz chapters me hai.

intents.title: Jummah aur Jamaat
intents.answer:
Jummah ki namaz mard ke liye farz hai (sharaet ke saath) — 2 rakat farz. Janazah nahi, balke khutba ke baad 2 rakat. Jamaat ke saath namaz 27 guna ziyada sawab deti hai.

Jummah aur jamaat ki puri sharaet Qanun-e-Shariyat ke chapters me hain.

intents.title: Eid ki Namaz
intents.answer:
Eid ki namaz 2 rakat wajib hai — Isha ke khilaf Eid me 6 takbeerein ziyada hoti hain (3 extra takbeerein). Khutba namaz ke baad hota hai. Mustahabb hai ke Eid ke din ghusl kar ke achhe kapre pahne jaayein aur raaste alag karein.

Tafseel Qanun-e-Shariyat ke Eid chapter me hai.

intents.title: Taraweeh
intents.answer: Ramzan me Isha ke baad 20 rakat Taraweeh sunnat-e-moakkadah hai. Jaldi ya dheere kisi bhi tareeqe se jamaat ke saath parhiye — Ramzan ki raaton ki qayam ka salah se sabse behtar amal hai.

intents.title: Musafir ki Namaz (Qasr)
intents.answer:
Safar me (mukaberati itne/safre masheel ke mutabiq sharai safar me) farz namazein 4 rakat ke bajaye 2 rakat (qasr) parhi jaati hain. Jama (zuhar+asr, maghrib+isha mila kar) bhi jaiz hai zaroorat ke waqt.

Sahi sharai muddat aur tafseel ke liye Qanun-e-Shariyat dekhein.

intents.title: Fitra (Sadaqat-ul-Fitr)
intents.answer:
Fitra har sahib-e-nisab musalman par Eid-ul-Fitr se pehle de dena wajib hai — dane, ya uski qimat. Mukiri ke mutabiq fitra ki miqdaar halqa ki qeemat par hoga.

Zakat aur fitra ke masail Qanun-e-Shariyat ke Zakat chapter me mausoom hain.

intents.title: Mehr aur Jahez
intents.answer:
Mehr shadi ka zaroori hissa hai — yeh ho to nikah sahi, na ho to bhi raat ko. Mehr ki miqdaar munasib ho. Jahez koi farz nahi, balke zulm hai agar zabardasti maanga jaye.

Nikah aur meer ke ahkam Jannati Zevar ke Nikah chapter me hain.

intents.title: Talaq aur Khula
intents.answer: Talaq shariyah me ek sakht maamla hai — iddat ka takhlif aur char mahine ka intezar. Khula me aurat de sakti hai. Ghar ke masail aur nikah ke chapters me in ahkam ki tafseel hai.

intents.title: Haiz aur Nifas
intents.answer: Haiz ki halat me namaz aur roza haram (ruk jaata hai), lekin roza baad me qaza karna hota hai, namaz ki qaza nahi. Nifas (bachhe ke baad) ke ahkam bhi isi chapters me hain — Jannati Zevar me auraton ke liye khass ahkam likhe hain.

intents.title: Akhlaq aur Haqooq
intents.answer: Achhe akhlaq Islam ka ahem hissa hai — maa-baap ke haqooq, rishtedari, aur logon ke saath hush e sulook. Jannati Zevar ke Akhlaq chapter me iski tafseel hai.

intents.title: Aqeedah aur Imaan
intents.answer: Imaan ka matlab hai Allah par, Rasool (ﷺ) par, Qayamat par, farishton par, asmaani kitabon par aur taqdir par yakeen. Tawheed sab se ahem hai — shirk se bachna har musalman par farz. Isi khaas baat ko quran-o-hadith me bohat samjhaaya gaya.

intents.title: Kalimah (Kalma)
intents.answer:
Islam ke 6 Kalme hain. Pehla Kalma Tayyibah: "La ilaha illallah, Muhammadur Rasoolullah" (Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi, Muhammad ﷺ Allah ke Rasool hain). Duj: Kalma Shahadat ("Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu..."). Kalma Istighfar, Kalma Tauheed, Kalma Radd-e-Kufr waghera bhi hain.

Kalme zuban se kahein aur dil se tasdeeq karein — ye imaan ki buniyad hai.

intents.title: Durood Sharif
intents.answer:
Durood Sharif parhne ka matlab hai Nabi ﷺ par salam aur rehmat ki dua. Sab se mash-hoor Durood-e-Ibrahim hai jo namaz ke tashahhud me parha jata hai: "Allahumma salli ala Muhammadin wa ala aali Muhammad..."

Jis par ek durood, Allah us par das rehmatein bhejta hai. Rozana durood parhne ki aadat banayein.

intents.title: Istighfar aur Taubah
intents.answer:
Istighfar ka matlab hai Allah se gunahon ki maghfirat maangna. Sab se aasan istighfar: "Astaghfirullah" — aur mazeed: "Astaghfirullaha rabbi min kulli zambin wa atubu ilaih" (Mujhe Allah se maghfirat chahiye har gunah se, aur main uski taraf palta hoon).

Allah taubah karnay walon se bahut mohabbat karta hai. Ikhlaas se taubah aur na karne ka azm — Allah maghfirat farmata hai.

intents.title: Azaan ka Jawab
intents.answer:
Azaan suntay waqt sunnat ye hai ke azaan ke kalimat same sun kar jawab diya jaye: muazzin "Allahu Akbar" kahe to "Allahu Akbar", "Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah" kahe to wahi kahein, magar "Hayya alal-salah" aur "Hayya alal-falah" par "La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah" kahein.

Azaan ke baad durood parhein aur ye dua: "Allahumma rabba hazihil da'wati-tammati was-salatil qaa'imati, aati Muhammadan al-waseelata wal-fadeelata..."

intents.title: Music aur Gaana
intents.answer:
Jamhoor ulama ke nazdeek music instruments aur geet (jo fahashi aur haraam cheezon par mushtamil ho) haraam hain. Naat aur hamd (bina music ke) jaiz hain.

Jo halal mele (allowed) hain unka imtinaa karna behtar hai. Dil ki tareeq se dua aur zikr ko apnayen — bura saath aur aadat se bachein.

intents.title: Sood (Riba) Haraam
intents.answer:
Sood (riba) Quran me khatta karam (strictly) haraam hai. Allah ne riba ko haraam kiya aur uskay baare me shadeed waid (warning) di hai. Bank ka interest, qarz par lene-dene ka sood — sab riba hota hai.

Halal rizq talash karein aur sood se bachein. Agar kahin unwittingly shamil ho gaye to taubah karein aur mamla halal tareeqe se set karein.

intents.title: Taweez aur Jadu
intents.answer:
Jadu (sihr) aur jinnat se madad maangna haraam hai. Shaytan aur jinnat ke zariye se ilaaj ya taweez jin me kalamat ya quran ki aayatein hoon un par ulama e ikhtelaf hai, lekin jadu se bachao ka sab se behtar tarika hai Quran aur sunnat ki duaayein — Ayatul Kursi, Surah Fatiha, Mu'awwidhat (Falaq-o-Naas), aur zam-zam waghera peena.

Jadu ka asar Allah ke hukm ke ba'is hi hota hai. Sab se ziyada roohani ilaaj Quran aur sunnat wale deRoob main hai. Nazar-e-bad se bachne ke liye "Ma sha Allah" aur durood parhna watchabi aamal hai.

intents.title: Miswak
intents.answer:
Miswak Nabi ﷺ ki sunnat hai. Unho ne farmaya: "Miswak moun ki paakiza-gi aur Allah ki raza ka zariya hai." Miswak har namaz se pehle aur wudu ke waqt istemal karna sunnat hai.

Miswak se moun saaf hota hai, boo khatam hoti hai aur thawaab milta hai.

intents.title: Daadhi (Beard)
intents.answer: Daadhi rakhna jamhoor ulama ke nazdeek sunnat hai, kuch ulma ka kehna hai ke wajib (farz) bhi ho sakti hai. Nabi ﷺ ne daadhi rakhne ka hukm diya. Musalman mard ko daadhi rakhna chahiye aur kam se kam ek musi-muth (fist) se ziyada katwana munasib nahi.

intents.title: Sabr aur Sukoon
intents.answer:
Sabr (patience) momin ki pehchan hai. Quran me Allah farmata hai: "Beshaq Allah un ke saath hai jo sabr karte hain" (Surah Baqarah). Mushk il aur takleef Allah ke imtihaan hote hain aur sabr karne par be-hesab ajr milta hai.

Takleef me wudu karke 2 rakat namaz parhein, istighfar aur dua karein. Har mushkil ke baad aam-e-raah (easy) aati hai — Allah ka waada hai: "Beshiq mushkil ke saath aasani hai."

intents.title: Ayatul Kursi
intents.answer:
Ayatul Kursi Surah Baqarah (2:255) ki aayat hai. Ye Quran ki sab se azimat wali aayat kehlati hai. Ise raat so kar parhne wale ki hafizat Allah karta hai.

Har farz namaz ke baad parhne ki bhi hadith me targheeb hai. Ayatul Kursi parhkar kisi se qarib na ho to hifazat rahti hai.

intents.title: Namaz ka Tarika
intents.answer:
Namaz ke andar ye cheezein hoti hain: (1) Niyat, (2) Takbeer-e-Tahrima ("Allahu Akbar" kehte hue haath bandhna), (3) Qiyam me Sana, A'udhu-Bismillah, Surah Fatiha aur koi surah, (4) Ruku (kam se kam 3 bar — Subhana Rabbiyal Azeem), (5) Sajdah (2 bar — Subhana Rabbiyal A'la), (6) Baithna aur Tashahhud, (7) Salam.

2 rakat me phir Ruku-Sajdah hoga, 3 ya 4 rakat wale agar andar beech me Tashahhud ke baad uthna hota hai. Mukammal tarz ke liye Qanun-e-Shariyat ka Namaz chapter parhein.

intents.title: Aulad aur Rizq
intents.answer:
Aulad Allah ka tohfa hai. Aulad ki dua karna sunnat hai — "Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa zurriyatina qurrata a'yun..." (Surah Furqan). Rizq, umr aur aulad sab Allah ke hukm se milte hain.

Nikal ki fikr na karein — Allah har zindah ka rizq likh chuka hai. Imaan aur amal-e-saleh par tawakkul karein, halal rizq talash karein.

intents.title: Surah Al-Kahf
intents.answer: Surah Al-Kahf (18wan surah) — jummah ke din parhne ki hadith me targheeb hai. Mushaf me khol kar misst parhein.

fallback.title: Deeni Taleem
fallback.answer:
Main sirf Islam aur deeni masail me madad kar sakta hoon — namaz, Quran, roza, zakat, hijab, nikah, talaq, dua waghera. Aap koi deeni sawal poochhiye, main jawab dunga.

Kuch aise sawal poochhein:
• "Namaz ke faraiz kya hain?"
• "Wudu kaise karein?"
• "Roza ke masail batao"
• "Ayatul Kursi kya hai?"
• "Surah Yaseen kholo"
